discovery: Prediction and discovery of baryon acoustic oscillations in the large-scale distribution of matter, establishing a standard ruler for cosmic expansion

nominees.name: Rashid Sunyaev
nominees.affiliation: Max Planck Institute for Astrophysics, Garching, Germany

motivation: Sound waves in the primordial photon-baryon plasma, predicted by Sunyaev and Zel'dovich in 1970, left a characteristic scale of about 150 Mpc imprinted on the matter distribution. In 2005, Eisenstein and collaborators (SDSS) and Cole and collaborators (2dFGRS) independently detected this baryon acoustic feature in galaxy clustering. Its physics is simple and linear, and its scale is calibrated by the cosmic microwave background, which makes it one of the most robust geometric probes known. It depends little on astrophysical systematics and can be checked against the CMB and distance-ladder routes. BAO confirmed the acoustic origin of structure and turned galaxy surveys into precision cosmology. It now underpins our measurements of the expansion history, dark energy and the Hubble constant. The recent DESI results, which hint at evolving dark energy, rest directly on this standard ruler.
